Both headings become « Tâches », and the item counts both become « tâches en cours », so a reader cannot tell which list is which. The glossary fixes job = tâche; the to-do family therefore needs a distinct noun (à faire / élément à faire). findings.reason: The first count plural uses explicit =0..=6 plus other. A count of 1,000,000 would take other and print « 1 000 000 agents intégrés » instead of « d'agents ». The list is the packaged built-in roster, so 1,000,000 is unreachable; recorded for completeness, not as a defect.

verdict.reason: 1 blocker (translated machine key) and 9 majors across 5 namespaces. The other 10 namespaces are clean or carry only minor findings.
verdict.summary: The batch is structurally sound (placeholders, ICU, plurals, NFC, markup) and mostly fluent, but one translated machine key breaks a lookup and several visible strings carry wrong meaning or terminology. Fix the blocker and majors, then re-audit the delta.
